## 438. A world's reorderings as courses of growth (UE15)

UE14 answered the root's open entry on presence in time on causal-set growth only ([§432](432.md#432-the-present-on-causal-set-growth-ue14)). The World reads its shared index of steps as one choice among interleavings: with a footprint containing the exchanges, exchanges not joined commute, and what shows of the index is the order of joined exchanges (01 §9.6). UE15 asks whether the two are one structure, so that UE14's laws hold on the World by instance and not by analogy, as the UE plan's first aim, representation, asks of a law ([plan](../../development/ue-unified-explanation/PLAN.md); [note](../../development/ue15-reorderings-as-growth/NOTE.md)).

**Its standing.** Every law is near-definitional, a composition, a lemma or a witness. The linear extensions of a trace's dependence order are exactly its interleavings (Mazurkiewicz 1977; Diekert and Rozenberg 1995), here the World's own form of it, landed as `Footprinted.sorts_iff`; the prefixes of a trace correspond to the down-sets of its dependence order, the configurations of its event structure (Nielsen, Plotkin and Winskel 1981); and in causal set theory the natural labellings are the linear extensions, read as the paths of sequential growth (Rideout and Sorkin 2000). Law 2 follows at once from these, and the review's light search found no paper connecting traces with causal-set growth. Presence giving persistence is an elementary consequence of a footprint containing the exchanges. What is new is the reading: the World's interleavings as causal-set growth, so one law of presence across the two models, and what presence means on the World.

**The review and the fix round.** An independent read-only review by another AI agent ([REVIEW-UE15](../../development/ue15-reorderings-as-growth/REVIEW-UE15.md), with a probe of 11 theorems in 15 declarations, every axiom report empty) found the Lean sound and pure core, each transfer composing the right law of UE14 with its decision and bounds, `Reordering` not satisfied so trivially that a law is emptied, and the witnesses what their docstrings say. It found the note wrong in one place, in 12 findings (1 error, 3 over- or understatements, 3 improvements, 5 on style), and every one is taken ([note §7](../../development/ue15-reorderings-as-growth/NOTE.md#7-review)). The gap between persistence and presence is not only dependence: a world with no dependence and the least footprint, moving a relatum and moving it back, has persistence without presence (MovedBack), and presence on the world as it is is stated exactly (present_identity_iff). The representation is of numberings: one course carries several numberings where the order has automorphisms (VeeWorld.one_course_two_numberings). Both bounds of present together are on the World (together_every_reordering_not_not); course_converse names the other world's footprint; the representation is stated with the module's own Reordering (reordering_iff_course); the empty flow is Witnesses.emptyFlow; what persists is named (persists_of_present). The module went from 49 theorems in 60 declarations to 59 in 73. The reviewer then re-checked the fold ([RECHECK-UE15](../../development/ue15-reorderings-as-growth/RECHECK-UE15.md), with a probe of 3 theorems, every axiom report empty): the fold sound, and 9 findings, every one taken. Moving a relatum and moving it back takes two exchanges, so the converse fails wherever what the earlier exchange touched persists while an exchange between is joined to it; 01's open entry, the UE plan and the Chinese texts state the representation of numberings; the statement says the first m steps; persistence is stated with the footprint containing the exchanges; and that the witnesses' only reordering is the world as it is is proved (reordering_nil, the re-check's probe). The module has 62 theorems in 76 declarations, every axiom report empty.

**Decisions at landing.** One module, one record, homed at 01 §9.6 after the order of exchanges as the invariant: the record is a theorem on the World's order of exchanges, and 01's open entry on presence in time is extended to it, keeping open presence on processes without a footprint, continuous time, the present of a center and weighted growths. The decisions are Prop-valued (`Decided`, `WeaklyDecided`), weaker than a Boolean or `Decidable` joining, so UE14's laws taking a `Decidable` instance of the whole precedence are not instanced; of their forms with no decision, those for taken before, present together and presence when taken are. The witnesses are three small new worlds with empty flows, since the World's existing witnesses have two exchanges and no fixed footprint. `Becoming.ReorderingGrowth` clashes with no name of the package.

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. On the World the present of UE14 is the present of a reordering: the exchanges taken by a step that no exchange taken by then follows in the order of joined exchanges. What every interleaving keeps of presence, or some interleaving has, is defined from that order, the one link and the link, and which presence holds between the two bounds is the choice of interleaving the step index makes. What the World adds is what presence means: on the world as it is, an exchange present when another is taken has nothing between joined to it, so it has left everything it touched as it left it; and an exchange can leave all that unchanged without being present, where an exchange between is joined to it while what it touched persists: through a dependence, a touch that does not move it, or a move that a later exchange between undoes. So the UE plan's first aim, one law and not one per model, holds here: the laws of presence are stated once, on causal-set growth, and hold on the World's stretches by instance through one representation, of numberings.
